contributions: Redesigned the legacy Satellite Mission Planner into a high-fidelity web app using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and HTMX with a strong emphasis on frontend architecture.
Collaborated on REST API design with FastAPI for seamless frontend-backend communication.

media.alt: SARC mission planner grid with satellite selection, a globe, and a clock

items.hoverText: I built a drag-and-drop grid that lets users arrange and view multiple interfaces at once.

media.alt: SARC mission planner CesiumJS globe demonstration

items.hoverText: I learned and integrated CesiumJS to display a basic interactive globe within the mission planner.

media.alt: Four versions of the SARC mission planner, from wireframe to dashboard

items.hoverText: I refined the interface through four high-fidelity iterations based on feedback. Looking back, low-fidelity prototypes would have helped me test ideas faster, but rebuilding the interface gave me valuable practice in web development.
